## IMPL-UNITGREEN-001: the unit suite green on both lab hosts (BDPv4: 0 failed, 0 skipped)

Operator, 2026-10-19: "BDPv4 requires all unit tests be green." and "There should be ZERO platform specific UNIT tests.  If it depends on the environment, it's an integration test." Plan: `docs/plans/2026-10-19-unit-suite-green.md` (approved 14:50; amendments in sections 7 to 9 and 11; execution record in sections 10, 12 and 14; decisions in section 13).

Draft until hostile validation (Codex gpt-6-astra max) returns AGREE at 98/98. No done state is claimed: every new or changed criterion is unsatisfied and every TODO task is unchecked.

### Commits (over develop `3da2db93`)

- `cbc74e82`: System.Security.Cryptography.Xml and Pkcs pinned to the advisory-patched 10.0.13 (TR-MCP-QUALITY-001 ac-21).
- `28bf0b22`, `de581353`: canonical workspace-key tests, provider traits, and the host-aware `WorkspaceIdentityPath.ToNativePath` overload (FR, TR and TEST-MCP-PATHNORM-001; additive public API).
- `a4c358ef`: narrowing to leave PLAN-C4MODEL-001's fixes to that effort (superseded by `11681680`).
- `b2319488`: the HostileReviewWorker startup test no longer depends on Event Log write access (TR-MCP-HOSTILEREVIEW-003).
- `11681680`: takeover of PLAN-C4MODEL-001's unit-suite code and Linux provider provisioning (TR-MCP-NUKE-018), blob-identical to `c2125c42`, by operator decision.
- `8c2b83ab`: host-scoped MigrationIntegrationTests lane (TR-MCP-NUKE-019 AC-1 to AC-4).
- `8a617334`: merge of develop with PR 86.
- `b2bd50b3`: platform-dependent tests classified as integration tests, with the unit-suite guard and a strengthened skip guard. Its first guard run, `unit-green-guard-mock-20261019T1720`, was red (4692 results, 1 failed, 16 not executed); see plan section 10.
- `4f668b76`: the plan and the PR 82 handoff correction.
- `59249260`: the interactive desktop-spawner case fails loudly as a Windows integration test.
- `69d8f3f5`: amendment H1, under which the Windows integration lane refuses a non-interactive session before any test (TR-MCP-NUKE-019 AC-5).
- `12746834`: the invalid-handle final-path case runs only on Windows, without a silent return.
- `83417029`, `6b4295b7`: docs only (the plan as built, the code-head receipts, the 19:41 decisions).
- `49cfec92`: hostile validation round 1, findings F3 and F5. One skip definition serves both guards and catches multiline, qualified and listed skip attributes; interpolation holes are kept as code; the project-selection limit is stated.
- `b4ad42aa`: round 1 finding F2. The 36 cases that reach a native file-system boundary or write tracked files move to Integration, with assertions unchanged. This is the last code, test or build change.
- Docs only after it: the plan's round 1 record, the round 1 HV receipts and the round 2 gate receipts. `git diff --name-only b4ad42aa..HEAD` lists only `docs/` paths.

### Gates at `b4ad42aa`

- Guard mock gate `unit-green-r2-guard-mockgate-20261019T2103`: a full Nuke Test with only the four guard files changed. 4624 total, 4624 passed, 0 failed, 0 not executed.
- Linux Test `unit-green-r2-test-20261019T2110`: 4588 total, 4588 passed, 0 failed, 0 not executed.
- Windows Test `unit-green-win-r2-20261019T2110` (PAYTON-LEGION2 over WSMan, HEAD verified): 4588 total, 4588 passed, 0 failed, 0 not executed. The WSMan lane in the same run refused before any test, as specified.
- Windows MigrationIntegrationTests from kingd's interactive desktop session `unit-green-win-interactive-20261019T2112`:
  - runner proof: `user=kingd session=1 interactive=True head=b4ad42aa`;
  - filter: `Category=Integration&Platform!=Linux`;
  - result: 164 passed (Support.Mcp 157, McpAgent 1, Build.Tests 6), 0 failed, 0 not executed;
  - route: the operator's SSH route as kingd started a one-shot task with the Interactive logon type, which was removed after the run (plan section 14).
- Linux MigrationIntegrationTests `unit-green-r2-int-20261019T2118`: 188 passed (Support.Mcp 171, McpAgent 1, Build.Tests 16), 0 failed, 0 not executed.
- ValidateTraceability `unit-green-r2-traceability-20261019T2120`: passed. It reads the committed `docs/Project` exports, which are stale (see Open).
- Full Build.Tests (raw `dotnet test`) `unit-green-r2-buildtests-20261019T2120`: 436 total, 436 passed, 0 failed, 0 not executed.
- Receipts: `docs/receipts/unit-suite-green-20261019/`.

### Hostile validation

- Round 1 (`unitgreen-r1`, HEAD `6b4295b7`): DISAGREE, 95/93, 5 PASS and 7 FAIL (F1 to F7, all implementer edits). Receipts: `docs/receipts/hv/20261019T195131-unitgreen-r1.*` and `hostile-validator-unitgreen-r1-20261019T195131.*`. The full result is in reviewer turn `req-20261020T005403Z-unitgreen-r1`. The remediation is recorded in plan section 14.
- Round 2: pending.

### Requirements

- TR-MCP-NUKE-019 created under FR-MCP-BUILD-001 (AC-1 to AC-5).
- FR-MCP-USECASE-016 and -017 converted into TR-MCP-USECASE-018 and -019 under FR-MCP-USECASE-001 and deleted; TEST-MCP-USECASE-019 and -020 restated for BDPv4; no use-case link to the deleted FRs remains.
- TR-MCP-QUALITY-001 ac-21 reopened and strengthened; TEST-MCP-PATHNORM-001 gained `unitgreen-native-host`.
- After AGREE, these are set satisfied (plan section 13, D-B): TR-MCP-NUKE-019 AC-1 to AC-5, TR-MCP-USECASE-018 AC-006, TR-MCP-USECASE-019 AC-008, TR-MCP-QUALITY-001 ac-21 and TEST-MCP-PATHNORM-001 `unitgreen-native-host`. AC-2, AC-3, AC-5, AC-006 and AC-008 rest on the round 2 evidence: the Windows interactive lane and the reclassification. The other 17 USECASE criteria stay unsatisfied.

### Open

- The requirements wiki export (`workflow.requirements.generateDocument`, wiki, all) fails on Linux. Retried at 21:18:51, it returned "Linux requirements export cleanup rejects nested stale paths before mutation because the kernel lacks a contained atomic delete" (`triage-report-a6927fca10364155ab9992506e1abc9c`). The generated `docs/Project` exports therefore stay stale and are declared here under goal item 4.
- Hostile validation round 2.
- Declared, not part of this PR: the two source-reading guards stay unit tests. A test tagged with both Platform values, or an unknown one, has no stated outcome; none exists today.

…isted skip attributes; interpolation holes kept as code (IMPL-UNITGREEN-001)

Hostile validation round 1 (gate unitgreen-r1), findings F3 and F5:

- F3: both guards missed a Fact/Theory skip attribute whose arguments span lines and a
  qualified one (Xunit.Fact, global::Xunit.TheoryAttribute, or later in an attribute list),
  and the platform scanner's string stripping erased code inside interpolation holes.
  UnitSuitePlatformScanner.FindSkipLines is now the one skip definition both guards use
  (IngestionAllowlistContractTests.SkipPattern is removed). It parses a test attribute's
  argument list with balanced parentheses across lines, accepts qualified and listed
  attributes and the xUnit v3 skip properties, and still ignores strings and comments. The
  lexer keeps interpolation holes as code, blanks the text around them, escaped braces,
  strings nested in a hole and a hole's format clause, and no longer treats a verbatim
  string that opens with an escaped quote as a raw string.
- F5: GuardProjectSelection_MatchesTheUnitTestTarget now states its limit: it pins the
  project list and does not read build/Build.Test.cs.

BDPv4 order: the scripted cases and negative controls were written first (scanner:
multiline-skip-attribute, qualified-skip-attribute, interpolation-holes, the round 1
counterexample controls, the hole-stripping test; skip guard: 19 scripted sources and the
controls proving the earlier single-line patterns miss them), then the lexer and pattern
change. Mock gate unit-green-r2-guard-mockgate-20261019T2103 was a full Nuke Test with only
these four files changed over 6b4295b7: 4624 total, 4624 passed, 0 failed, 0 not executed
(4611 plus the 13 new cases). The Test target has no focused filter, so the corrected
scanner also ran in that run's two repository scans, which passed. Compile first:
unit-green-r2-guard-compile-20261019T2100, 0 warnings, 0 errors.
